dedupe_keys.name: traffic and transportation survey of highways trafik ve ulasım bilgileri turkiye kgm

description: The Traffic and Transportation Survey of Highways (Karayolları Trafik ve Ulaşım Bilgileri) is a bilingual yearbook from the Transport Studies branch of the Traffic Safety Department of Türkiye's General Directorate of Highways (KGM). Coverage: motorways and state highways by regional directorate, with annual average daily traffic by traffic section, speeds, traffic section and volume maps, annual vehicle-km, passenger-km and tonne-km, and lengths of roads by traffic volume class. Seasonal factors come from continuous counting and classification stations, with 534 count points across the country cited in the method. Format and access: a PDF yearbook each year; the 2024 edition was published in May 2025. Older traffic volume maps for 2010 to 2012 are on a separate KGM page. Licence and cost: free; no licence stated. Caveats: tables are in PDF, so they need extraction; provincial roads are covered only in the older maps. The yearbook supplies link volumes and freight and passenger flows for national road network flow and capacity models. It relates to the KGM road inventory statistics and the GB road traffic counts in the catalogue.
